source_title: Rapport om eksport af projektarkiv til legacy Data Ping bootstrap
accepted_elements: preserve original run IDs and raw date strings without invented normalization
retain undated or missing-run-id records rather than dropping them
separate private raw source intake from sanitized public structured observations
require stable source IDs, source hashes, extraction receipts and source-message lineage
retain contradictions and supersession instead of silently reconciling them
use explicit review and rejection queues for uncertain or unsafe records
keep deterministic ordering and reproducible integrity checks
excluded_elements: generic GitHub branch and pull-request guidance
arbitrary relevance score weights and thresholds
external legal and platform guidance not specific to framework history
claims of archive coverage or exported record counts
reason: The report explicitly states that it contains no actual archive findings or production export files. Its value is limited to a small set of intake and provenance controls, most of which reinforce existing bootstrap governance.
